name: Abbottabad
registryBasis: Urban Area Development Authority Abbottabad (UADAA) publishes the Abbottabad Township Scheme Phase-I master plan and states that official plot and allotment records are provided through its portal. This supports a local planned-township property-record workflow only; it does not establish a citywide land registry or publicly queryable parcel polygons.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The township map is a visual engineering/master-plan presentation and directs users to the portal for official plot/allotment records. No anonymous georeferenced full-polygon parcel schema or feature endpoint was verified; the map covers the planned township, not Abbottabad citywide.
scopeLimits: Source discovery only. Evidence establishes local registration or land-record services as qualified in registryBasis; citywide cadastre coverage and public vector access are not established. No owner, address, tax, personal-identity, credential or account lookup was submitted or retained. No full parcel geometry was retained.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separate anonymous public parcel-vector service exists and whether the relevant record units cover the settlement point remain unverified.
